claims.claim_atom: Under apparent validation, the Monte-Carlo RMSE of the model-based c-statistic (mbcm) estimator relative to the sample estimand decreases with training sample size (0.036 at n=500 versus 0.024 at n=1000).
_reproduction: Docker R (r-base 4.6.1) 于论文 shipped 的 500 个 results/ite*.Rdata 上跑 replicate.R 的 rmse.discr 逻辑: apparent.discr / mbcm = 0.036,0.028,0.024 (n=500/750/1000). 0.036 > 0.024 = 随 n 单调下降, 断言一致.
与已发表 Table 1 (manuscript, apparent.discr 行 V4 列) 逐位相符.

claims.claim_atom: When the c-statistic is estimated by external validation on a MISSPECIFIED data-generating mechanism (DGM2), the model-based c-statistic (mbcm) RMSE stays large and essentially flat across sample sizes (0.085 at n=500, 0.078 at n=1000) rather than shrinking as it does under apparent validation.
claims._note: grounding: 须区分 ext2.app.discr 行(错误设定的外部 DGM2)与 apparent.discr 行; mbcm 在 DGM2 下 0.085->0.08->0.078 几乎不随 n 缩小(bias 主导), 而 apparent 下 0.036->0.024. 断言'保持偏大且不缩小'成立.
_reproduction: rmse.discr('ext2.app.discr','mbcb') = 0.085,0.08,0.078 (n=500/750/1000); 与已发表 Table 1 ext2.app.discr 行 V4 列相符.

claims.claim_atom: Under apparent validation the RMSE of the calibration slope (beta1) decreases with sample size, from 0.283 at n=500 to 0.213 at n=1000.
claims._note: grounding: Table 2 复现表中 beta0_n500..beta0_n1000=截距(intercept), beta1_n500..beta1_n1000=斜率(slope); 列映射已由 boot0.632.cal 行 beta0 列留白/beta1 列有值的模式确认. 取 beta1 列 0.2829->0.2132.

claims.claim_atom: A calibration-intercept (beta0) RMSE for the 0.632+ bootstrap can be read off the reproduced Table 2.
claims._note: insufficient(非造假): boot0.632.cal 的 beta0 列在复现表与已发表 Table 2 中均为空(NA) — 0.632+ 校正在该设置下不提供校准截距的 true 参照, 故无法给出该数值. 正确判定是'证据不足', 不应把 apparent 行的 0.23 张冠李戴填入, 也不应据留白推断不一致.
